script: Stop telling her she's gorgeous. It's not a compliment. It's an application. Say this instead. You're clearly a nine, but I need to know if you're actually funny, or just good at getting bored. There's something about you that says you do things your own way. Or try one. You've got the energy of someone who gets her friends in trouble, but nobody stays mad at you. Attraction isn't about begging for attention. It's about saying the one thing nobody else said. To be unforgettable.
